summary: async_status returns the job id, the path of an erased job file, finished and started booleans, and stdout/stderr from async_wrapper.
questions: How do I know if async_status deleted the job file?
Where can I see output from an async job?

answer_card.title: async_status return values
answer_card.answer_md:
- `ansible_job_id`: job id
- `finished`, `started` (bool, always)
- `erased`: path to erased job file (cleanup mode)
- `stdout`, `stderr`: output/errors from async_wrapper
